Press Release Article - Angel’s Pizza Secures Top Honors in 2025 Delivery Platform Awards

November 24, 2025 – Angel's Pizza, one of the Philippines' leading and most-loved pizza chains, proudly announces its recent dual victory in the highly competitive online food delivery space. The company has been honored with the prestigious Grab Platinum Fan Faves Award for the third consecutive year, solidifying its status as a constant favorite among GrabFood users. Furthermore, Angel's Pizza has also clinched the Silver Award for Pau-Pau Momentum Master at the recent Foodpanda Crave Awards.The Grab Platinum Fan Faves Award is a testament to Angel's Pizza's consistent popularity, high order volumes, and exceptional customer ratings on the Grab platform. Achieving this elite status for three years in a row underscores the brand’s unwavering commitment to quality, taste, and reliable service—making it the trusted choice of consumers.In addition, Foodpanda’s Silver Award for the Pau-Pau Momentum Master is a distinction given to brands that exhibit strong growth, operational agility, and standout performance in the Foodpanda ecosystem.“Foodpanda is thrilled to deepen our growing partnership with Angel's Pizza and bring their much-loved products even closer to customers nationwide. As a platform focused on unmatched convenience, we ensure that Angel's Pizza is easily accessible, with every order delivered quickly and reliably,” said Trixia Dichoso, Senior Manager, Strategic Account Management at Foodpanda. “We’re proud to offer exclusive deals and discounts that make Angel’s Pizza’s signature comfort food more affordable and enjoyable for our users.”These accolades come alongside exceptional sales performance in Angel’s Pizza’s aggregator channels. The brand has achieved strong double-digit sales growth compared to the same period last year, with much of this momentum driven by strategic partnerships with GrabFood and Foodpanda. This reflects the brand’s expanding digital footprint and the increasing online demand for food delivery.“We are incredibly humbled and ecstatic to receive the Grab Platinum Fan Faves Award for the third year running,” said Mr. Justin Liu, Figaro Culinary Group Chairman. “This award reflects the love and loyalty of our customers. We continue to be dedicated to serving our customers with quality product at affordable prices. I would like to thank our team for the hard work. docs.text:
RLC Q1 Net Income Climbs to ₱4.40B, Anchored by High Liquidity and Low Gearing

Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) reported strong first-quarter 2026 results, with consolidated revenues rising 11% to ₱12.28 billion, and net income increasing 9% to ₱4.40 billion, driven by the strength of its diversified portfolio and improved contributions from its development businesses, while net income attributable to equity holders of the parent stood at ₱3.54 billion.

docs.text:
Notes Facility of IDC Prime, Inc. with Italpinas Development Corporation acting as guarantor

At a meeting of the Board of Directors on February 6, 2026 the Board of Directors approved and noted the entry by its subsidiary, IDC Prime Inc. (“IDC Prime” or the “Issuer”), into a proposed corporate notes facility of up to PhP1,000,000,000.00 (the “Facility”), and further approved IDC’s participation as guarantor in connection therewith. The proposed issuance of the corporate notes will be conducted as an SEC-exempt offering, and the offering will be limited exclusively to Qualified Buyers under Rules 10.1.3 and 10.1.11 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of the Securities Regulation Code.The net proceeds from the Facility are intended to be used to fund the development, construction, and completion of IDC Prime Inc.’s Baia Verde residences project located on a 2.3-hectare property in Morong, Bataan, including associated project costs and working capital requirements directly related to the Project.

Attached is the SEC Form 17-C.
